a2-unit-09.09.1 Messages:
Megan: Hi everyone! I'm looking for friends from Lakeside College, class of twenty ten. Do you remember me? Megan Clark, from the history club.
Tom: Megan! Of course I remember you. It's Tom, from the same history classes. I haven't seen you for ages! What are you doing these days?
Megan: Tom! So good to hear from you. Well, after college I worked in Chicago for a few years, but in twenty fifteen I moved to Seattle. I've lived there for eleven years now. I'm a nurse at a children's hospital.
Tom: Wow, Seattle! I've always wanted to go there. I'm still in Chicago. I started teaching at a high school in twenty twelve, and I've worked there since then. I've also taught English online since twenty twenty. One of my students is a doctor from Brazil.
Megan: That's so cool! Are you married?
Tom: No, I'm not. But I've had a cat called Pancake for five years. He's the boss at home! And you?
Megan: I got married in twenty eighteen, so we've been married for eight years. We don't have kids, but we've had a dog for two years. His name is Biscuit.
Tom: Pancake and Biscuit! They sound like a breakfast menu.
Megan: Ha! Is your sister still baking?
Tom: Yes! Kate has had her own bakery for years. It's called Sweet Kate. You have to visit!
Megan: I'm going to Chicago in March for a conference. Let's meet at Sweet Kate!
Tom: Great idea!
